title: Adaptive Station Live Pilot — doc_update_v75_80 snapshots + diff + sim (tokenomics integrated)
abstract: Integrates tokenomics (agent_budget.json) into workflow-scoped snapshots; regenerates v4 and v0.2 priorities for 'doc_update_v75_80', then updates diff and weighted wait simulation.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.prioritize_workflow import snapshot
from meta.diff_priorities_param import run as run_diff
from meta.simulate_scheduler_param import run as run_sim

WF = "doc_update_v75_80"

v4_path  = snapshot(WF, mode="v4")
v02_path = snapshot(WF, mode="v02")

diff_out = run_diff(WF)
sim_out  = run_sim(WF)

print(json.dumps({
    "v4": v4_path,
    "v02": v02_path,
    "diff": diff_out,
    "sim": sim_out
}, indent=2))
